verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a TypeScript auth framework, and its ecosystem could plausibly ship an in-product AI assistant, so this axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The hosted remote MCP server serves docs search and setup help to external agents such as Cursor and Claude Code. The MCP plugin and the 'agent delegation' messaging cover auth for outside agents, not a native assistant inside the product.
